title: run a container worker on a hardened host image
input: The platform owner selects a supported COS image and the approved container artifact.
action: Container-Optimized OS supplies the host kernel and supported container runtime environment. The workload container executes the application; image updates and host access settings are managed separately from application releases.
output: The worker performs its assigned job and persists output outside temporary host storage.
check: Test container compatibility, host replacement, security settings and application recovery under the selected image version.

title: build a validated enterprise analytics model from supported source data
input: The data team selects supported enterprise source schemas and the relevant Cortex analytical content.
action: Cortex Framework supplies supported reference content and deployment assets for enterprise data analytics. Deployed pipelines and BigQuery models perform ingestion and transformation; the source mapping must match the business system.
output: The analyst queries the accepted curated model and uses the relevant dashboards or analytical templates.
check: Reconcile source transactions, transformation rules and business measures before accepting the deployed analytical model.

title: publish an authorized reporting dashboard from selected sources
input: The analyst defines the permitted data source, report calculations and viewer audience.
action: Data Studio's supported reporting experience connects to configured sources and renders report visuals. Connection credentials and sharing settings determine available data; report calculations need reconciliation with the source.
output: The viewer opens the shared dashboard and sees the permitted business measures.
check: Check data credentials, report sharing, calculation accuracy and refresh behavior before publication.

title: transfer application data across a supported multicloud path
input: The architect specifies participating cloud services, data residency constraints and the supported transfer configuration.
action: Data Transfer Essentials supplies supported multicloud data-transfer capabilities under the selected offering and connectivity configuration. Application clients perform the actual data exchange; residency and transfer conditions must be verified for the chosen path.
output: The destination application receives only the permitted dataset or service response over the configured connection.
check: Check eligible providers, routing, transfer charging and end-to-end integrity before accepting the multicloud path.

title: release a reproducible training job using a supported framework image
input: The ML engineer pins the framework container and approved training code and dataset.
action: Deep Learning Containers supply supported preconfigured framework images. The training platform runs the image and the user's code performs model training; the image itself is not a managed training scheduler.
output: The training job persists accepted checkpoints and records the image digest and framework configuration.
check: Test accelerator compatibility, dependency versions, data access and repeatable evaluation before changing the image.

title: run a framework-based experiment on a prepared compute instance
input: The scientist selects a supported deep-learning VM image and permitted accelerator configuration.
action: Deep Learning VM images provide preinstalled supported ML tooling on Compute Engine. The notebook or training script executes the experiment; the owner manages VM lifecycle, data permissions and framework compatibility.
output: The scientist stores accepted experiment code and model artifacts outside disposable VM state.
check: Check driver and framework versions, dataset access, checkpoint restart and secret removal before sharing artifacts.

title: connect an approved source repository to a cloud build workflow
input: The repository owner approves the supported connection and scoped repository access.
action: Developer Connect establishes supported connections to developer repositories and services. A configured build workflow fetches the permitted revision through that connection; build execution occurs in its actual runner.
output: The release pipeline builds and tests the selected commit without exposing broad repository credentials.
check: Test connection scope, revoked access, commit identity and untrusted pull-request behavior before enabling release triggers.

title: test an application on authorized remote device instances
input: The developer selects the supported device configuration, test artifact and permitted device-farm access.
action: Developer Device Platform orchestrates supported remote devices for building or testing applications. The test runner installs and exercises the application on the selected devices and collects available execution evidence.
output: The developer reviews device-specific failures and accepts only the build passing its required device coverage.
check: Test device isolation, artifact cleanup, test credentials and reproducibility across the supported device types.

title: route a support conversation through intent matching and a webhook
input: The user sends a permitted support message through the application's configured chat channel.
action: Dialogflow ES matches the utterance to configured intents and extracts supported parameters. A configured fulfillment webhook performs authorized business lookups; intent matching alone does not retrieve the customer's order.
output: The webhook returns the permitted order status and the conversation presents that response to the user.
check: Test fallback intents, ambiguous parameters, webhook authentication and cross-customer access denial.

title: extract invoice information with a configured document processor
input: The invoice handler submits a permitted document to the selected supported processor.
action: Document AI's processor parses supported documents and returns structured text, layout or extracted fields. The application reconciles supplier identity and totals; extraction confidence is not payment approval.
output: The accounts-payable reviewer approves corrected fields before the application posts the invoice.
check: Check processor version, file format, duplicate invoices, extraction evidence and financial-data permissions.
